description: Config form spec for one gpio Sensor entry in devicecfg.json Sensors[]. Flattened Properties; native DTDL writable + Enum coverage; the rest is in config-rules.js. gpio.isSupported is a boolean capability flag (SensorGroup=SYS); gpio.pinState is an integer level reading per pin (SensorGroup=DI, with PinId / PinIds).
comment: Pin identifiers are integer indices only. PinId / PinIds mutex when both non-empty; both are only valid when MetricName='pinState'; MetricName='isSupported' MUST NOT carry PinId / PinIds. SensorGroup / SensorInfo.Schema vary by MetricName (isSupported -> SYS / boolean; pinState -> DI / integer) -- cross-field consistency enforced by config-rules.js.

schemas.description: Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType='gpio'.
SensorGroup allow-list for gpio sensors. isSupported -> 'SYS'; pinState -> 'DI'.
Wire schema allow-list. isSupported -> 'boolean'; pinState -> 'integer'. Cross-field rule enforced by config-rules.js.
Informational. Logical level for a GPIO input pin. The agent emits the underlying integer (0 / 1); consumer dashboards may resolve to the named label via this Enum.
Array<integer> schema referenced by the PinIds Property. DTDL v2 requires complex schemas (Array / Object / Map) used by Properties to be declared in schemas[] rather than inline.

contents.name: Name
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty ASCII string, 1..128 chars, unique within Sensors[]. Uniqueness enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Name
UI hint: text input on create; read-only after.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: SensorGroup
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'SYS' when MetricName='isSupported'; MUST equal 'DI' when MetricName='pinState'. Cross-field rule enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorGroup
UI hint: dropdown auto-selected by MetricName.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: MetricType
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'gpio' for this Interface.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricType
UI hint: fixed label, not editable.
Writable: immutable -- changing it requires defining a new Sensor.

contents.name: MetricName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from GpioMetricName. 'isSupported' takes no extra parameters; 'pinState' uses PinId / PinIds.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricName
UI hint: dropdown.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: PinId
contents.description:
OPTIONAL (gpio-specific, v1.0 mode, MetricName='pinState' only).
VALIDATION RULE: non-negative integer pin INDEX (e.g. 4). Resolved at runtime via GpioMetrics.PinIndexToName[index]. Mutex with PinIds (config-rules.js rules.gpio). MUST NOT appear when MetricName != 'pinState'.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.PinId
UI hint: number input, min=0. Hide unless MetricName='pinState' AND PinIds is empty.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: PinIds
contents.description:
OPTIONAL (gpio-specific, v1.1 mode, MetricName='pinState' only).
VALIDATION RULE: array of non-negative integer pin indices (e.g. [4, 17, 27]). Empty array means auto-detect. Mutex with PinId (config-rules.js rules.gpio). MUST NOT appear when MetricName != 'pinState'.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.PinIds
UI hint: number-chip / tag input. Hide unless MetricName='pinState' AND PinId is empty. Empty = auto-detect.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Enabled
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: boolean.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Enabled
UI hint: toggle / switch.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able (SIL2 maintenance lever).

contents.name: Interval
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: integer, 1 <= v <= 300000 (5 minutes). Range enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Interval
UI hint: number input, min=1, max=300000, step=100, default=6000.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Description
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Description
UI hint: textarea or text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: DisplayName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.DisplayName
UI hint: short text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Schema
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'boolean' when MetricName='isSupported'; MUST equal 'integer' when MetricName='pinState'. Cross-field rule enforced by config-rules.js; the agent rejects startup on mismatch.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Schema
UI hint: dropdown auto-selected by MetricName.
Writable: immutable after creation.
